newsitem.title: USA: January U.S. aluminum shipments up from year ago.
newsitem.headline: January U.S. aluminum shipments up from year ago.

text.p: Primary aluminum shipments in the U.S., including exports, rose 13.8 percent to 1.841 billion pounds in January compared to a year ago, the Aluminum Association reported.
But compared to December 1996, shipments in January were down 7.2 percent from the revised total of 1.7 billion pounds.
Domestic shipments in January totaled 1.59 billion pounds, up from 1.514 billion in December and 1.415 billion in January last year.

U.S. exports of aluminum ingot and mill products in January were reported at 250 million pounds, up 23 percent over the previous year. Imports totaled 439 million pounds in January, down 5.3 percent from the previous year.
During February the Association's order index fell to 99.62, compared to 105.84 in December and 89.04 in February last year.
Can stock orders fell to 97.07 in February from 107.35 in January and 109.92 in February last year.
Scrap consumption in January rose to 734.1 million pounds, up 17.21 percent from the January 1996 total.
